concept.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reference for a game-ready 3D environment landmark in an ant-scale fantasy RTS, Under the Canopy. Create one isolated 'Bitter Heart': a large corrupted living-tree root organ, inside a hollow tree. Three massive asymmetric curled dark roots rise around a central split woody seed-shaped heart, open at the front. Highest root behind left curls inward like a crooked arch, shorter right root curls forward, a third buttress supports the back. The central heart is an upright swollen wooden pod, cracked into five chunky pointed bark plates, revealing a narrow glowing copper-red resin core. Broad branching roots spread low and firmly along the ground into a single cohesive base. Deep bark grooves, muted slate-brown wood with a subtle plum cast, warm exposed torn heartwood, small desaturated ochre shelf fungi and sparse dark moss at feet. Broad bold readable silhouette, premium hand-painted stylized 3D game asset, practical low-poly construction, no thin filigree, no many tiny spikes, no eyes or mouth, no skull, no stone temple, no chains, no circular platform. The core is resin, not a faceted crystal. Roughly 13 units wide, 9 deep, 11 high. Black background, no floor plane, isolated with generous margin, orthographic three-quarter front view from 25 degrees elevation. Soft warm key, cooler fill, restrained internal red glow; retain all geometry in shadows. No text or UI, no creatures. Show a coherent sculptural organic form that can be faithfully reconstructed with curved root meshes and chunky bark plates.
